generation.prompt:
Create one photorealistic vertical 9:16 educational photograph of Archaeological excavation (考古发掘现场). The result must look like a single candid real-world photograph, never a collage, cutaway diagram, catalogue layout or labelled illustration.

SCENE DIRECTION
Photograph a real archaeological dig in warm early-morning light from the corner of one shallow excavation trench. Let taut grid strings cross the upper edges while a ranging pole stands clearly at the back. In the middle, one archaeologist kneels beside—not on—the foam pad, with hands paused away from the targets. Place the pointing trowel and soft brush separately on clean soil beside one prominent pottery shard. Set the finds tray and recording board on opposite trench ledges, and lean the soil sieve where its mesh is visible. Preserve soil layers, scale and safe working posture. No skeletons, treasure piles, fantasy ruins, readable notes, modern litter, multiple shards presented as targets or tools hidden under dust.

REQUIRED LEARNING TARGETS
Show exactly one clear primary instance of each of these ten targets: archaeological excavation trench, archaeologist pointing trowel, archaeology hand brush, ancient pottery shard, archaeological finds tray, excavation grid string, survey ranging pole, archaeological soil sieve, field recording board, excavation kneeling pad.

COMPOSITION AND LEGIBILITY
Distribute the targets across the upper, middle and lower thirds and across both sides of the portrait frame. Preserve realistic scale, perspective, contact shadows and spatial relationships. Every target must have a distinct silhouette, be large enough to identify on a phone screen, and remain fully visible rather than hidden behind a person, furniture or another target. People may perform natural actions, but their hands and bodies must not cover the learning targets. Keep incidental background objects visually quiet.

STRICT EXCLUSIONS
No captions, vocabulary labels, subtitles, watermarks, brand logos, readable signage, licence-plate text or gibberish lettering. No duplicated target objects, floating objects, malformed hands, extra limbs, distorted tools, impossible reflections or physically incoherent architecture.
